description: This file defines the TestStoreGrainState class used for persistence testing in Orleans, including methods for generating random state data.

classes.name: TestStoreGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of a grain, with properties A, B, C, and a method to generate random state instances.

methods.name: NewRandomState
methods.description: Creates a new GrainState with randomized property values, optionally specifying the length of property A.

methods.name: GenerateRandomDigitString
methods.description: Generates a random string of digits of specified length.
